quote: Live, then, and be happy, beloved children of my heart, and never forget that until the day when God shall deign to reveal the future to man, all human wisdom is summed up in these two words,—‘Wait and hope.’
source: Alexandre Dumas, The Count of Monte Cristo, chapter 117, the farewell letter (Edmond Dantès) (trans. anonymous, Chapman and Hall, 1846)
speaker: Edmond Dantès, in his letter to Morrel and Valentine
